title: The age of the whole truth; healed of a cold
summary: The practitioner calls this the age of Christian Science; Thomas studies it and is healed of a cold overnight.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Yes. Well, you're jumping now. I want you to get to what you ...(??)...

So I went to this practitioner, and one of the first things he told me, he said, "My boy, we are living in the greatest age that Man ever lived in. We are living in the age of the whole truth." Then he went on to elaborate it: "We are living in the age of Christian Science." That's the way he (?) it.
So this other comforter is coming with the whole truth.
And do we know who he is? How do we find out about that?
That's the other half of the truth that Christ didn't (?).

That's the thing that he didn't... He taught it, but it was above their heads. But Christian Science brings it down to our level of thinking, where we can pick up on it. Because you remember, the Master talked about the Spirit, and then one thing he said that shocked a lot of

people, he said, "Call no man upon this Earth your Father. Your Father is the one which art in Heaven." Meaning that we were spiritual beings. And that's one of the basic thoughts of Christian Science, that we are spiritual and not material. And it's kind of hard to think when you've been through all this Jazz all your life...
Aha! So it's kind of hard to think about that, being (?)through it(?).

And so I got interested in it, and I studied it thoroughly. And I found out so many things that they said in Science that proved... Because the one thing it teaches you how to pray... And I had been thinking that when I tried it, I tried it to see if it worked. And the first working it had on me, I got healed of a cold overnight. And I said, "It's got to be something" -- because usually it takes me a week or two to get rid of a cold.
